code.extract_of: the clock only. It runs tornado_tick.py with --offline and the clock pinned to the time the published run read (the generated field of data/tornado_live.json), which the desk uses to tell a settled or passed row from an open one

name: TORNADO
sources: SPC Day 1 Convective Outlooks, one zip per year, from the Iowa Environmental Mesonet archive, https://mesonet.agron.iastate.edu/request/gis/outlooks.phtml (data/raw/outlooks/day1_YYYY.zip).
The SPC tornado database 1950 to 2025, https://www.spc.noaa.gov/wcm/ (data/raw/db), and SPC preliminary storm reports (data/raw/prelim).
NWS storm-based tornado warnings from the Iowa Environmental Mesonet archive, https://mesonet.agron.iastate.edu/vtec/ (data/raw/warnings).
US Census cartographic state boundaries, cb_2024_us_state_20m.zip, https://www.census.gov/geographies/mapping-files/time-series/geo/cartographic-boundary.html (data/raw/boundaries).
why_not_included: its inputs are about 550 MB of SPC outlook archives, storm reports, warnings and boundary files, more than a public kit carries. Every source is public domain and listed below, and each file is named with its sha256
